title: Restrictions along adjoint continuous functors of sites are adjoint; uniqueness of the left adjoint
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$, $\mathcal D$ be sites and $\lambda:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, $\beta:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ functors with $\lambda$ left adjoint to $\beta$, with counit $\varepsilon:\lambda\beta\to\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal D}$ and unit $\theta:\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}\to\beta\lambda$. Assume that precomposition with $\lambda$ carries sheaves of sets on $\mathcal D$ to sheaves of sets on $\mathcal C$, and precomposition with $\beta$ carries sheaves of sets on $\mathcal C$ to sheaves of sets on $\mathcal D$ (so the same holds for sheaves of abelian groups, whose sheaf condition is that of the underlying presheaf of sets). Write $\Ab(\mathcal C)$, $\Ab(\mathcal D)$ for the categories of abelian sheaves, $\lambda^s:\Ab(\mathcal D)\to\Ab(\mathcal C)$, $G\mapsto G\circ\lambda$, and $\beta^s:\Ab(\mathcal C)\to\Ab(\mathcal D)$, $F\mapsto F\circ\beta$. Then:

1. $\lambda^s$ is left adjoint to $\beta^s$, with unit $u_G:G\to\beta^s\lambda^sG=G\circ\lambda\circ\beta$ given at $W\in\mathcal D$ by the restriction map $G(\varepsilon_W):G(W)\to G(\lambda\beta W)$, and counit $F\circ\beta\circ\lambda\to F$ given at $V\in\mathcal C$ by $F(\theta_V):F(\beta\lambda V)\to F(V)$.
2. If $L:\Ab(\mathcal D)\to\Ab(\mathcal C)$ is any functor left adjoint to $\beta^s$, with unit $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to\beta^sL$, then there is a unique natural isomorphism $\rho:L\xrightarrow{\sim}\lambda^s$ with $\beta^s(\rho_G)\circ\eta_G=u_G$ for every $G$; i.e. for every $W\in\mathcal D$, $\rho_G(\beta W)\circ\eta_G(W)=G(\varepsilon_W):G(W)\to G(\lambda\beta W)$.
